new_value: Added normative proof-of-possession requirement to spec/appendix-x509-cert-profile.md (lines 19-30, directly after the PKCS#10 mention). The CA MUST verify the PKCS#10 certificationRequestInfo self-signature over the DER-encoded tbsRequest using the subject public key (RFC 2986 §4.2), MUST reject unverifiable requests, and MUST NOT issue without verified PoP; no extra PoP round trip required. This closes the rogue-key/key-substitution hole for the Ed25519 attestation cert (a cert could previously bind a SAN address to a key the requester does not control, undermining the §8 step 4 attestation). Placement keeps all section numbers/cross-refs stable; references Section 4 (SAN) and Section 8 step 4 correctly. Validation: typos clean on changed lines (the two COSE->CASE flags are pre-existing false positives, COSE is correct RFC 9052). 3x codereview: pass1 correctness=kimi-k3 via opencode PASS (verified PKCS#10 mechanism vs RFC 2986 §4.2 + Note 2, both cross-refs, keyword usage); pass2 security=opencode timed out x2, performed by worker model: PASS (self-sig PoP defeats rogue-key via EUF-CMA; orthogonal to §8 step4/§5 roles; no alg-substitution forgery); pass3 edge=kimi-k3 via opencode PASS (no contradiction with §7/§8/§9, well-defined for Ed25519, no placement ambiguity, consistent with line 16). Pre-existing nit (RFC 2119 declaration omits REQUIRED/RECOMMENDED) filed as P4 project-LICHEN-worker6-pors. Committed 1976c59a94.
